posts.title: Does code matter anymore ?
posts.description: Code has always been considered as Craft. You could tell “well crafted” code from the alternative just by looking at it. It required time, patience, an opinionated outlook and effort, amongst other things. Developers took pride in their code. Just as an artisan would take pride in theirs. posts.description: When working with coding agents such as Claude, Codex etc. we provide the prompts and context until we get to the final result. However a lot happens behind the scenes. posts.title: Challenges in an AI First world
posts.description: There is an AI race going on. No one knows where or what the finish line is, but it’s a race nevertheless. Run or be left out. So everyone is running.
